limitations_and_boundaries: The study is limited to three cancer cell lines (A549, MCF7, K562) and 188 compounds.
The 72-hour time course was performed only in A549 cells with 48 compounds.
TC50-IC50 correlation excluded two relatively insoluble compounds.
Heterogeneity analysis focused on HDAC inhibitors; generalizability to other compound classes is not fully explored.
The study uses in vitro cell line models; in vivo relevance is not addressed.

methods.name: Nuclear hashing

experiments_or_tasks: HDAC inhibitor-treated cells from three cell lines were aligned using MNN to produce a consensus HDAC inhibitor trajectory (pseudodose). Heterogeneity of response was assessed. A 72-hour time course with 48 compounds in A549 was performed to test asynchrony. TC50 values were calculated and compared to published IC50 values. Differential expression analysis was performed along the pseudodose trajectory.
